name: basics: orient on the instance before doing anything
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy. The first minute of a session: what server is this, what can it do, what is in front of me. Reading the tool panel is the expensive call in that sequence -- raw it is ~25k tokens on a 170-tool server -- so a scenario that asks about the toolset is also the one that would show the cost returning.
inputs: What Galaxy server am I on, and what version?
Roughly how many tools does it have, and what sections are they organised into?
Is there a tool here for concatenating datasets? Give me its id.
